suspension.reason: A redacted archive scan reported one unclassified generic-api-key match in evidence/RUNTIME_PROVENANCE.out. The candidate is frozen; the pilot is suspended fail-closed pending maintainer classification and independent review.
suspension.resume_requires: A versioned maintainer classification, a bounded scan policy if the finding is a documented false positive, a clean redacted archive scan, and independent review. A confirmed secret requires revocation, a rebuilt candidate and requalification.

qualification_session.renewal_requires: A new versioned authorization after a documented integrity review; expiry is not extended implicitly.

suspension_authority.authority_scope: May suspend this pilot unilaterally on any automatic suspension trigger or any credible security concern.
suspension_authority.delegation: No delegation is valid unless recorded in a replacement version of this authorization.
suspension_authority.fail_closed_rule: If this authority is no longer controlled or cannot be identified, the pilot is suspended.

approved_scope.allowed_purpose: controlled local pilot while the native SystemVault qualification is prepared

public_release.promotion_forbidden_until: All five gates in PUBLIC_RELEASE_GATE_STATE.json are PASSED with fresh versioned evidence and independent review.

required_next_qualification.target: Ubuntu 24.04.4 LTS amd64 native graphical user session, outside a container, without sudo, with unlocked Secret Service

expiry_rule: This authorization automatically expires at qualification_session.expires_at and is automatically invalid upon any suspension trigger, candidate-chain or approved-scope change, or loss of the named suspension authority. It neither modifies nor supersedes PUBLIC_RELEASE_GATE_STATE.json.
